description.value: Sabzi Mandi Supermarket is a 100% family-owned South Asian grocery chain with 15 locations across BC, established in 1991 to serve the South Asian community's demand for fresh produce and specialty groceries unavailable elsewhere in the region. The Richmond location stocks fresh fruits and vegetables, a wide range of specialty and international groceries, household items, and cooking appliances. It is a useful full-service resupply stop for touring cyclists looking for a broad selection of fresh food and pantry staples.
